title: panicum divisum
intro: Panicum divisum, commonly known as Switch Grass, is a perennial grass native to North America. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Panicum divisum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
